case.summary: Case HHG-015 involves an online card-not-present transaction executed on a new device (`id_15` = New) running Trident/7.0 on Windows 8.1, which triggered a card_not_present_new_device pattern. Although the history ledger shows prior confirmed fraud cases on both this card tuple and a different card belonging to the customer, as well as an amount significantly deviating from typical spend and a high-decile bank model score, several mitigating factors strongly counter these risks. Specifically, Vesta's first-seen-on-this-card device flag heavily leans toward cleared alerts such as travel or a new phone rather than confirmed fraud, and the baseline model scoring alongside device behavior heavily discounted the overall threat level. Consequently, the calibrated probability of fraud is very low at 0.02, leading to a legitimate verdict. In accordance with the policy engine's decided actions for case HHG-015, the system will CLOSE_NO_FRAUD.
